mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id as userId, u.profile_photo_path as profilePhotoPath, u.birth_date as birthDate, u.gender, u.region, u.hobby, u.status_message as statusMessage, u.today_mood as todayMood, m.background_color as backgroundColor, t.theme_id as themeId FROM minihome m LEFT JOIN user u ON m.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN theme t ON m.theme_id = t.theme_id WHERE m.minihome_id = #{minihomeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET profile_photo_path = #{profilePhotoPath}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, gender = #{gender}, region = #{region}, hobby = #{hobby}, status_message = #{statusMessage}, today_mood = #{todayMood} WHERE user_id = ( SELECT user_id FROM minihome WHERE minihome_id = #{minihomeId} )
